description: The lineage of a table or view: the objects its index is built from (upstream) and the objects built from it (downstream), following the definingSQL of materialized views and search indexes.

rootId.description: The id of the object the lineage was requested for.

nodes.description: Every object in the lineage, the root included.

isTruncated.description: True when the lineage was cut short by maxDepth or by the limit on the number of nodes.
